paper_metadata.title: Shape Memory Effect in Quaternary NiTiHfPd Shape Memory Alloys beyond 200 °C
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Materials Engineering and Performance

evidence.quote: In this study, the effects of minor palladium (3 and 5 at.%) addition to ternary NiTiHf shape memory alloy (SMA) were investigated to design a high-temperature NiTiHfPd SMA.

In the microstructure of NTHP-5, white secondary phases were detected. These secondary phases seemed relatively large containing a considerable volume fraction of the microstructure. The white phase is also found along the grain boundaries.
A third darker phase was observed to encircle the white phases throughout the microstructure except on grain boundaries.
